CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

No âmbito da parceria com a Enel Distribuição São Paulo e Ceará, a AVSI Brasil atuará a partir de 2025 na execução e formatação sistemática do PROGRAMA ECOENEL - Troca de resíduos por bônus na conta de energia. Esta iniciativa considera a educação ambiental, por meio da reciclagem, como elemento fundamentador da construção de uma sociedade com maior responsabilidade social e ambiental.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O/a Coordenador Operacional atuará no monitoramento e análise de dados do projeto, apoiando na elaboração de relatórios periódicos de desempenho das metas e demais atividades administrativas do projeto. Além disso, ficará responsável pela coordenação da equipe operacional e relacionamento com o cliente.

  1. Coordenar as atividades operacionais e administrativas referentes ao projeto e à equipe;
  2. Coordenar o orçamento do programa, assegurando o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros, acompanhando a execução orçamentária, controlando despesas, e garantindo o cumprimento das regras e diretrizes estabelecidas pelo contrato e pelos procedimentos da AVSI;
  3. Coordenar as atividades e metas de desempenho a serem cumpridas pela equipe, e laborando a programação das atividades da equipe e ajustando a estratégia sempre que necessário;
  4. Organizar a logística de campo, elaborando documentos comprobatórios que evidenciem o desenvolvimento das atividades realizadas;
  5. Coordenar os processos de gestão de equipe, tais como admissão, demissão, controle da jornada de trabalho, férias, monitoramento do desempenho, entre outros;
  6. Selecionar e contratar todos os colaboradores necessários para realização das atividades e dos eventos, cumprindo as diretrizes organizacionais e as especificações do projeto;
  7. Coordenar os processos administrativos para aquisições de materiais, contratação de serviços e gestão de pessoas zelando pela correta aplicação dos procedimentos administrativos da AVSI Brasil, e em conformidade ao Plano de Aquisições do projeto;
  8. Monitorar os processos de gestão de estoque, a fim de garantir a adequada performance do escritório e das ações do projeto;
  9. Enviar periodicamente informações para o setor de Comunicação da AVSI para divulgação de matérias ou notícias nos canais institucionais da organização;
  10. Contribuir para a elaboração de documentos descritivos necessários à prestação de contas do projeto;
  11. Participar de reuniões com a CONTRATANTE para fins de acompanhamento e planejamento das ações, sempre que solicitado;
  12. Articular parcerias com outras organizações para fortalecer as ações do programa, sempre que necessário;
  13. Realizar todos os estudos, acompanhamentos, reportes necessários;
  14. Acompanhar e monitorar o envio dos relatórios dentro dos prazos estabelecidos;
  15. Implementar, acompanhar e monitorar os KPI`s do serviço (gestão a vista);
  16. Produzir apresentações mensais com dados gerais do projeto;
  17. Realizar missões e atividades em outros territórios ou escritórios da AVSI no Brasil, quando necessário;
  18. Participar de momentos formativos e de trabalhos propostos pela Organização;
  19. Cumprir suas atribuições conforme descrição do cargo, Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil, e Procedimentos Operacionais Internos;

About the role
Location: On Site - São Paulo
As a Customer Success Manager at Digibee, you will play a vital role in driving the successful adoption and utilization of our Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) solutions. You will be a trusted advisor to our B2B customers, guiding them through their integration journey and ensuring they achieve maximum value from their investment in Digibee. This role requires a strong understanding of integration concepts, excellent communication skills, and a passion for helping customers succeed.
On a daily routine you will..

  • Onboarding and Implementation:
    • Lead the onboarding process for new customers, providing comprehensive training and support on Digibee's iPaaS platform.
    • Collaborate with customers to understand their integration needs and develop tailored implementation plans.
    • Guide customers through configuring and deploying integrations, ensuring a smooth and efficient process.
  • Relationship Management:
    • Build and nurture strong relationships with key stakeholders within customer organizations.
    • Conduct regular check-in meetings to review integration performance, address any challenges, and identify opportunities for improvement.
    • Act as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries and support requests related to Digibee's iPaaS solutions.
  • Value Realization:
    • Proactively monitor customer usage of the platform and identify opportunities to optimize integrations and improve business processes.
    • Educate customers on advanced features and functionalities of Digibee's iPaaS to unlock further value.
    • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the impact of integrations on customer business outcomes.
  • Retention and Expansion:
    • Proactively identify and mitigate any risks that could lead to customer churn.
    • Develop and execute strategies to increase customer satisfaction and loyalty.
    • Identify and pursue opportunities to expand customer usage of Digibee's iPaaS through upselling and cross-selling.
  • Advocacy and Collaboration:
    • Act as a customer advocate within Digibee, providing feedback to product development and engineering teams to enhance the platform.
    • Collaborate effectively with internal teams (sales, support, engineering) to ensure seamless customer experience.
What you'll need to bring
  • Proven experience in a customer-facing role, preferably within a SaaS or technology company.
  • Strong understanding of integration concepts, APIs, and iPaaS solutions.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to build rapport and establish trust with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Proactive and solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Experience using CRM software (e.g., Salesforce) and other customer success tools.
  • Familiarity with Winning by Design methodology is a plus.
Benefits:

  • Continuous learning and development opportunities
Our culture
We believe in a highly collaborative work environment in order to foster constant development and exchange between teams. We encourage learning, sharing knowledge, and using new technologies to create disruptive ideas - we want to create something great together!
At Digibee, we know it's our people who make the difference. We embrace and value diversity and are dedicated to encouraging a supportive and respectful culture in our community.

description:

Buscamos um advogado tributarista com expertise em tributação direta e indireta (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, ICMS) e sólida experiência na análise de balanços e demonstrações financeiras. O profissional será responsável pela identificação de créditos tributários, revisão de balanços patrimoniais e DREs, além do suporte estratégico a clientes na recuperação de tributos e otimização fiscal.

O candidato ideal deve ter experiência prática na área tributária, com forte capacidade analítica para revisar demonstrativos financeiros e identificar oportunidades fiscais, seja por meio de teses tributárias ou benefícios já regulamentados.

Papeis e Responsabilidades

  • Revisão de balanços patrimoniais e demonstrações financeiras para identificação de créditos tributários
  • Assessoria estratégica para otimização fiscal em tributos diretos e indiretos (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, ICMS)
  • Análise e aplicação de teses tributárias relevantes para recuperação de tributos
  • Suporte a clientes na implantação e operacionalização de estratégias tributárias
  • Acompanhamento da legislação e obrigações acessórias (SPED Fiscal, EFD-Contribuições, etc.)
  • Interface com contadores, auditores e demais stakeholders para validação de estratégias fiscais

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação em Direito (OAB ativa). Pós-graduação em Direito Tributário será um diferencial
  • Conhecimento técnico avançado em tributos diretos e indiretos (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, ICMS)
  • Experiência prática em análise contábil e fiscal, com foco na identificação de créditos tributários
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de balanços patrimoniais e DREs
  • Familiaridade com SPED Fiscal, EFD-Contribuições e outras obrigações acessórias
  • Experiência prévia em consultoria tributária ou escritórios especializados

Diferenciais

  • Passagem por empresa de consultoria/auditoria Big Four (PwC, EY, KPMG, Deloitte) ou equivalente
  • Formação complementar em Contabilidade ou experiência prática na área contábil
  • Experiência com teses tributárias relevantes e identificação de oportunidades fiscais
  • Conhecimento em Softwares de gestão tributária

Sobre a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC)

Há 120 anos no Brasil, a ACSC é responsável pela administração de 19 entidades com atuação social, em saúde e educação, que formam a Rede Santa Catarina. Com um modelo de gestão em que o superávit gerado é aplicado em nossas obras a fim de executar dignamente nossas atividades, a instituição acolhe e cuida do ser humano em todo o ciclo da vida. Ao todo são cerca de 10,5 mil colaboradores distribuídos em diversas instituições de saúde, mantendo inúmeros estabelecimentos de ensino e acolhendo crianças, adultos e idosos em espaços assistenciais, com atendimento humanizado e serviços de qualidade para milhares de pessoas em seis Estados brasileiros (Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina e São Paulo).

MISSÃO

Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

VISÃO

Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

VALORES

Preservação da vida, Humanização, Dignidade, Transparência e Sustentabilidade.

This role is an opportunity to learn how the odds evolve during a game. The In-play Trading team is responsible for covering all live in-play events and plays a crucial role in shaping our customer experience.

An In-play trader manages events from a wide range of sports, including football, basketball, tennis but also general sports such as volleyball, ice-hockey, beach volleyball etc. They even offer special markets in many of them, surpassing those by other operators. ECOSEC

What We Do

Our ECOSEC team provides a safer experience for Epic's users. We work across multiple products and services to improve technology and craft transparent policies so our players and users can have positive experiences on our platforms.

Epic Games is looking for a Backend Security Engineer focused on Asset Integrity to protect sensitive game assets from unintended information disclosure.   • 3+ years of software engineering experience, with experience in backend development for games

  • Experience working with data analytics to solve, prevent, or monitor for problems
  • Knowledge and/or experience mitigating security vulnerabilities in sandboxes / virtual machines and potential mitigation strategies
  • Experience building or working with CI/CD environments
  • Experience working with building and deploying container images

title: Software Engineer (Rust)
description:
We are a global leader in the application and security industry. Our platform allows companies to operate with agility, reducing latency and increasing the reliability of their applications. We are focused on simplifying application building and looking for passionate and innovative individuals to join our team!

At Azion you will have the opportunity to develop and be connected to cutting-edge technology, immersed in a culture centered on innovation and a high-performance team, unlocking new possibilities and working with the future of technology.

About The Position

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Engineering team at our São Paulo/SP office. As part of the Engineering department, the selected candidate will be responsible for developing highly concurrent systems in Rust, optimizing performance, distributed caching, and connection management to handle thousands of requests per second with low latency.

  • Concurrent and Asynchronous Programming: Implement highly concurrent systems in Rust, leveraging async/await and efficient thread management to handle thousands of requests per second;
  • Performance Optimization: Optimize system resource usage, including memory management and throughput maximization, ensuring low latency even under high load;
  • Distributed Caching Management: Develop and maintain efficient caching systems across a globally distributed network, addressing challenges such as consistency and cache invalidation;
  • Upstream Connection Management: Maintain stable and efficient connections with upstream services, including load balancing, automatic reconnections, and backpressure management in large-scale network communication.

Requirements

  • Experience in systems development with Rust and low-level programming;
  • Understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and TLS;
  • Familiarity with secure development practices;
  • Familiarity with Linux and operating systems;
  • Knowledge of version control (Git);
  • Background in containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Knowledge of CI/CD and automation pipelines;

Differentials

  • Experience with Edge/CDN;
  • Experience with TCP sockets and Unix sockets;
  • Familiarity with Internet protocol RFCs;
  • Knowledge of HTTP proxy cache daemons such as Nginx, Caddy, and Envoy;

We offer a FlexWork model that prioritizes acculturation and collaboration. For the first three months, you will work on-site in the local office, an essential step in building solid relationships and a genuine connection with our values and culture. We believe that this initial immersion not only strengthens the team but also boosts creativity and innovation.

After this period, you will have the possibility to apply for the hybrid model, working on-site at least three times a week. This approach balances interaction in person and autonomy, creating a dynamic and productive working environment.

At Azion, all applications are welcome, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, pregnancy, disability, ethnicity, color, country of origin, or religion. We believe that an inclusive environment contributes to our success and that respect is present in all our relationships.

Come and join our team! We look forward to getting to know you and walking a path of success in technology together!

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes.   • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento;
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RV, RF, Fundos, Previdência, entre outros);

  • Conhecimentos de macroeconomia e sua conjuntura atual;

  • Presencial em Campinas e proximidades.

  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: preferencialmente presencial para frentes de negócio, predominantemente remoto para times de tecnologia e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. title: Facilities Manager
description:
Why the American University of Iraq—Baghdad?
Opening its doors in January 2021, the new American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB) began as a dream of influential individuals in Iraqi and United States business, industry and government who want to see a world-class institution of higher learning established in the city, reminiscent of the days when Baghdad was an educational mecca and flourishing capital of the Muslim world. With a great library, palatial college buildings and student centers, state-of-the-art classrooms, laboratories, and athletic facilities, AUIB will be a beautiful campus, attracting students, faculty, and staff from throughout the world. We invite you to join us in this exciting new venture.

Job Summary

The Facilities Manager is responsible for strategic and operational team-oriented leadership of the physical plant while working collaboratively with third-party service providers that provide services to the university. The Facilities Manager plans, leads, and coordinates the construction of campus facilities with third-party providers, including facility renewal, maintenance, and repair.

Responsibilities

The primary core responsibilities, as indicated below:

  • Develop long- and short-term plans for the construction, renovation, repair, and maintenance of physical plants, collaborating with third-party service providers.
  • Coordinate with third-party service providers to ensure that renovations, repairs, and maintenance are completed in a timely manner and that facilities are in excellent working order.
  • Serve as the university’s representative during the construction of major campus infrastructure projects.
  • Provide guidance and advice on the development of the university’s physical plant.
  • Provide schedule reports and other feedback as necessary on the progress of construction, renovations, repairs, and maintenance.
  • Support the use of technology to enhance operations, improve the campus infrastructure, and reduce energy costs.
  • Ensure projects are completed on schedule, within budget, and comply with applicable codes and regulations.
  • Provide formal and informal training programs as needed to provide relevant knowledge and skills to plant personnel.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related study, with a preference for a Master’s degree.
  • Five years’ demonstrated experience leading small to large projects.
  • A proven record of leadership in facilities management with budget experience.
  • The ability to lead with both a decisive and consultative style, foster open communications, and proactively build positive relationships.
  • A track record of overseeing the complex construction of campus facilities.
  • A team player who fosters collaboration across the organization and has a commitment to excellence.
  • Physical capacity for prolonged standing, walking and climbing stairs with exposure to outdoor elements.

Required

To be considered for any role at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB), applicants are required to submit the following documents:

  • Cover letter: This should detail how your skills and experience align with the specific requirements of the position you are applying for.
  • Resume/Curriculum Vitae: Please provide an up-to-date resume or CV.
  • Identification: A valid national ID or passport is required for the application process.
  • Please note that applications missing any of these components will not be considered.

Shortlisted Candidates

If you are shortlisted for an interview, you will need to provide additional documentation:

  • Educational transcripts and certifications must be translated into English.
  • References: You must provide contact details for three references. These individuals should be those who have either worked with you or supervised your work.

We look forward to receiving your complete applications and appreciate your interest in joining our dynamic team at AUIB.

  • Apply technical knowledge of aircraft engine systems in determining equipment malfunctions and use required expertise in restoring equipment condition and/or operation.

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Working knowledge of technical publications and Logistics Information Systems.

Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in substations (up to 500kV) and energy transmission projects across global markets.

We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, contribute to energy transition solutions, and bring excellence to our electromechanical and protection systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)
  • Prepare and analyze layout drawings, grounding mesh, cable routing, and auxiliary systems (AC/DC)
  • Design single-line, three-line, and interconnection diagrams
  • Ensure compliance with international standards (IEC, ANSI, IEEE, ABNT)
  • Perform technical documentation review and approval (FATs, BOMs, technical specs)
  • Interface with clients, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams
  • Contribute to engineering reports including ROI, CAPEX, and technical feasibility

What We’re Looking For:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in high-voltage substation design (preferred: 230kV to 500kV)
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD (See Electrical, Eplan P8 or similar is a plus)

  • Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
  • Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
  • English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus

Bonus:

  • Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)

Why Join Us:

  • Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems

  • Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture

Who is Xelvin?

Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.

Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!

As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.

· 1-2 year contract of 40 hours per week (with potential of long-term employment).

· 25 paid holidays a year (+ potential ADV days)

In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.

· You (and your family/partner) will be picked up at the airport or train station by your consultant/ recruiter after your arrival and will be taken to your new house.

· Onboarding: we’ll advise you on how to set up a Dutch bank account, apply for health insurance, getting a Dutch BSN number, writing in with a dentist and general practitioner and other useful or necessary cases to arrange.

· New Hire Dinner organized for all newly recruited engineers to make them aware of our Dutch tax system and explaining the Dutch payslip.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What you'll do

As a Quality Engineer at Tractian, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the highest quality standards for our hardware products and solutions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including design, manufacturing, and quality assurance, to ensure that our products meet rigorous quality requirements and exceed customer expectations. Additionally, you will be responsible for identifying and collaborating with suppliers who share our commitment to excellence, further enhancing our supply chain efficiency and ensuring the consistent quality of the materials used in our products. Your expertise will contribute significantly to our mission of delivering exceptional IIoT solutions to industries worldwide.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the design and manufacturing teams to define quality standards, specifications, and inspection criteria for mechanical components and assemblies.
  • Conduct thorough quality assessments of incoming materials, ensuring they meet specified requirements and are free from defects.
  • Develop and implement quality control processes, including inspection plans, testing procedures, and relevant documentation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and corrective actions for any quality issues identified during testing or production, and track these actions to closure.
  • Participate in the design review process to provide insights on potential quality concerns and ensure design for manufacturability and assembly (DFM and DFA).
  • Conduct regular audits of manufacturing processes to identify opportunities for improvement and ensure adherence to quality standards.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to improve component quality, resolve quality-related issues, and drive continuous improvement in the supply chain.
  • Work closely with the production team to support process validation and ensure consistency in manufacturing processes.
  • Maintain accurate records of quality assurance activities, including test results, inspection reports, and non-conformance documentation.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of quality documentation, including standard operating procedures, work instructions, and quality manuals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a Quality Engineer, preferably in a manufacturing or technology-driven environment.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical engineering principles, materials, and manufacturing processes.
  • Familiarity in quality tools, methodologies, and documentation such as 8D, DMAIC, NCR, EA, and statistical process control.
  • Experience with inspection techniques, metrology, GD&T, and non-destructive testing methods.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to lead root cause analysis investigations.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 or other quality management systems is a plus.
  • Reading and Writing English proficiency.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with microcasting and sintering.
  • Experience with plastic injection and mold manufacturing.
  • Strong understanding of Reliability Engineering and its tools.
  • Spanish proficiency.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Education and courses stipend
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years
  • Day off during the week of your birthday
  • Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities

title: Controller
description:
O Controller é um profissional estratégico no ambiente corporativo, com foco na gestão financeira, contábil e de controle interno. Ele desempenha um papel essencial no planejamento, monitoramento e análise do desempenho econômico da empresa, garantindo a precisão dos dados financeiros e a tomada de decisões fundamentadas.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  1. Planejamento e controle financeiro: Elaborar e acompanhar o orçamento anual (budget) e previsões financeiras (forecast). Monitorar a execução orçamentária e propor ajustes para alinhar os resultados aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa. Desenvolver e acompanhar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs).
  2. Gestão de contabilidade e demonstrações financeiras: Supervisionar a contabilidade geral (terceirizada), garantindo a conformidade com normas locais e internacionais. Revisar e validar demonstrações financeiras, como balanço patrimonial, demonstração de resultados e fluxo de caixa. Realizar análises financeiras para subsidiar relatórios gerenciais.
  3. Auditoria e compliance: Coordenar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo suporte e garantindo a transparência dos processos financeiros. Implementar e monitorar controles internos para mitigar riscos financeiros e operacionais.
  4. Gestão de custos: Monitorar e analisar custos operacionais para identificar oportunidades de redução e otimização. Implementar e acompanhar sistemas de controle de custos por produto, projeto ou unidade de negócio.
  5. Suporte estratégico e decisório: Atuar como parceiro estratégico da alta gestão, fornecendo análises e recomendações financeiras. Participar no desenvolvimento de estratégias de crescimento e alocação de recursos. Avaliar viabilidade de projetos e investimentos, considerando retorno financeiro e impacto no negócio.
  6. Liderança e gestão de equipes: Liderar equipes de contabilidade, controladoria e finanças, promovendo capacitação e desenvolvimento profissional. Garantir a integração das áreas financeiras com outros departamentos da organização.

Requisitos: Ciências contábeis completo. Desejável especialização em controladoria, auditoria ou áreas afins. Experiência em rotinas contábeis, financeiras e controladoria - tributação lucro real. Inglês será um diferencial.

Contrato CLT + benefícios (VR R$24,00 por dia trabalhado + VA R$550,00 por mês). 50% do plano de saúde, convênio odontológico e seguro de vida em grupo.

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: preferencialmente presencial para frentes de negócio, predominantemente remoto para times de tecnologia e híbrido para as demais equipes.
